item.title: Alleged narco-terrorists killed as US forces strike suspected drug-trafficking vessel in Caribbean
item.summary: SOUTHCOM says Joint Task Force Southern Spear conducted a lethal strike in the Caribbean on March 25, killing four narco-terrorists on a vessel along known drug-trafficking routes.

item.title: Joy Behar has sharp clash with GOP guest after questioning military's accomplishments in Iran
item.summary: Joy Behar debated GOP guest host Abby Huntsman on "The View" over what the U.S. military has accomplished in Iran, as Behar claimed the operation only buried the Epstein files.

item.title: Trump boosts GOP war chest as House Republicans gear up for high-stakes midterm fight
item.summary: House Republicans will announce a record haul at the NRCC fundraising dinner headlined by Trump as they fight to defend their slim House majority.

item.title: Florida AG warns NFL: Drop affirmative action ‘Rooney Rule’ or face legal consequences
item.summary: Florida AG James Uthmeier warned NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell to drop the Rooney Rule by May 1 or face civil rights enforcement actions under Florida law.

item.title: Meet Iran's hardline speaker who threatened to burn US forces — reportedly Tehran's point man for talks
item.summary: Iranian parliament speaker Ghalibaf has threatened U.S. forces while reportedly being eyed by the Trump administration as a potential Iran talks channel.

item.title: DAVID MARCUS: Why are we letting foreign foes use X payouts to wage war against us?
item.summary: X's proposed monetization changes could stop foreign bot farms from funding divisive U.S. creators, but Elon Musk has delayed the policy for review.

item.title: Kevin O'Leary says removing Iran from Strait of Hormuz would be a global 'game changer'
item.summary: 'Shark Tank' star Kevin O'Leary says removing Iranian control of the Strait of Hormuz would be a global game changer, calling the shift 'very bullish' for world markets.

item.title: Melania Trump welcomes humanoid robot to White House for historic AI summit
item.summary: First Lady Melania Trump on Wednesday hosted a global tech summit at the White House East Room, featuring the Figure 03 humanoid robot.

item.title: Dems block DHS funding after GOP rejects their counter, Thune says Schumer 'going in circles'
item.summary: The DHS shutdown impasse deepened Wednesday as the Senate GOP rejected Democrats' latest offer, with Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D., arguing there was "no point" in countering.

item.title: Suspect in fatal New Jersey hit-and-run crash is illegal alien, fugitive: DHS
item.summary: Wilson Morocho-Necta, 33, was charged in a fatal hit-and-run in Morristown, New Jersey, and a federal source identified him as an illegal alien from Ecuador.
